title: Setup: read-only view of configured federation hosts and Remotes, their relationship and live connection state (no secrets)
outcome: Setup: read-only view of configured federation hosts and Remotes, their relationship and live connection state (no secrets)
acceptance: The Settings dialog has a "Setup" tab placed before Remotes. It shows this host's identity, role and federation enabled state, then two labelled sections: every configured federation peer, and the saved Remotes. A federation peer with no matching Remote stays visible, with an explanation. The existing Remotes editing tab keeps working. Setup performs no mutation, probe or polling.

In GET /api/federation, each peer row carries a read-only `linkConnected`, computed by the same rule as `satellite.centralPeer.linkConnected` through one shared helper, with Rust tests on central and satellite. The UI shows "Connected" only when that explicit current flag is true in a successfully fetched snapshot. It shows authentication; verification (current, needs recheck, or unverified); connecting or retrying; connection error with fixed copy for each SSH class; disabled or held; and unknown, each separately. Past success alone never yields Connected. The relationship display distinguishes a unique SSH endpoint match (labelled "identity not confirmed"), possible or ambiguous matches, local, and not linked. Loading or error never displays as "not linked".

Only allowlisted display fields reach the DOM. Vitest covers sentinel-secret fixtures for pairCapabilityRef, hostKeyRef, knownHostsRef and raw error text; the loading, empty, per-row partial, first-load error and stale-refresh states; a single-column layout at ~320 px; and keyboard disclosure and refresh. Refresh happens only on open, manual action or transport reconnect, is deduplicated, and a stale completion cannot overwrite a newer snapshot. tsc, the affected Vitest suites and the Rust focused tests pass on the frozen tree, and an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
